newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia may have De Beers deal by March.
newsitem.headline: Russia may have De Beers deal by March.

text.p: Russian Foreign Trade Minister Oleg Davydov said on Friday that Russia could sign a gem export deal with De Beers by the end of this month.
"The signing of an agreement is possible by the end of the month," he told reporters in the Urals city Yekaterinburg.
"The agreement with De Beers is now undergoing government approval, after which it will be signed," said Davydov, who is also a deputy prime minister.
He made no further comments on Moscow's long-stalled export deal with the South African gem group.

The Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS) diamond-producing monopoly, which is De Beers' negotiating partner, said earlier this week that consensus had been reached and all of the government's questions about the deal had been dropped.
De Beers stopped purchases of Russian diamonds at the end of last year when it cancelled its interim arrangement after Russia failed to approve or reject a new trade deal.
Russia had said it had objections to the deal and called for changes, and ARS said earlier this week that some unspecified concessions, or changes, had been made.
